$schema: Nusuk DL template contract v1 (see 14-templates-and-patterns.md; DESIGN.md › M9T)
name: Address selection

band.rule: Takes the band of the service that uses it; commitment state inside it is band 2.

job: Choose a saved place or add a new one.
useFor: Selecting or adding an address during a transaction.

forbidden: Closing that discards typed input without a warning.

allowed: SelectCard or Radio rows for saved addresses, at least 48 high.
forbidden: An address selected in advance that the person did not choose before.

allowed: A map with MapPin; StatusSheet · template location for the permission, location-settings after a refusal.
forbidden: A permission request with no stated reason.
A map as the only way to enter an address.

allowed: TextField: Input, Select, Mobile; Hint for errors.
forbidden: A placeholder as the only label.
Asking again for data already given (M10).

allowed: One Primary that confirms the address.
forbidden: A disabled Primary that hides validation.

rules: Errors name the field and how to fix it, next to the field (M6, M10).
The Primary stays enabled; on tap it shows what is missing.
Phone numbers and postcodes in digits 0 to 9, left to right inside Arabic (M6).
Location is asked once, with its reason.
A service limit (area not served) is stated here, not discovered at payment.

allocation.App level: L3 · a task inside a transaction step. No entry of its own.
allocation.Withheld: P0 for Dependents and Organised groups, with the transaction.

allocation.Inherits: Marketplace: DNA Supportive · band 6 · interrupts for offers are T3 · suppressed in sacred windows.

example.inTheFlowToday: Built from Auxiliary Task (X) Only; the confirm action is disabled until the form is valid.
